package http_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	httptransport "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http"
	adminhandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/handlers"
	apihandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	privatehandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/personalteacher"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/teacherdialog"
)

type ensureStub struct {
	teacher domain.PersonalTeacher
	err     error
}

type nextActionStub struct {
	studentID string
}

func (stub *nextActionStub) Execute(_ context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherNextAction, error) {
	stub.studentID = studentID
	return domain.TeacherNextAction{Schema: domain.TeacherNextActionSchemaVersion, PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherNextActionPolicyVersion, Status: "NO_PROGRESSION", ReasonCode: "path_completed", SecondaryActions: []domain.NextActionChoice{}, SourceVersions: domain.TeacherNextActionSourceVersions{StateDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}}, nil
}

func (stub ensureStub) Execute(_ context.Context, _ string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	return stub.teacher, stub.err
}

type updateStub struct {
	teacher domain.PersonalTeacher
	err     error
	input   *personalteacher.UpdateInput
}

func (stub *updateStub) Execute(_ context.Context, input personalteacher.UpdateInput) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	stub.input = &input
	return stub.teacher, stub.err
}

type getStub struct {
	teacher domain.PersonalTeacher
	err     error
}

type soulStub struct {
	soul domain.TeacherSoul
	err  error
}

func (stub soulStub) Execute(_ context.Context, _ string) (domain.TeacherSoul, error) {
	return stub.soul, stub.err
}

type soulUpdateStub struct {
	soul  domain.TeacherSoul
	err   error
	input *personalteacher.UpdateSoulInput
}

type provisionDialogStub struct {
	binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding
	err     error
	input   *teacherdialog.ProvisionInput
}

func (stub *provisionDialogStub) Execute(
	_ context.Context,
	input teacherdialog.ProvisionInput,
) (domain.TeacherDialogBinding, error) {
	stub.input = &input
	return stub.binding, stub.err
}

func (stub *soulUpdateStub) Execute(
	_ context.Context,
	input personalteacher.UpdateSoulInput,
) (domain.TeacherSoul, error) {
	stub.input = &input
	return stub.soul, stub.err
}

func (stub getStub) Execute(_ context.Context, _ string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	return stub.teacher, stub.err
}

func testTeacher() domain.PersonalTeacher {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	teacher, _ := domain.NewPersonalTeacher("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "student-1", domain.DefaultPersonalTeacherSettings(), now)
	return teacher
}

func testSoul() domain.TeacherSoul {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	soul, _ := domain.NewTeacherSoul(
		"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "student-1", domain.DefaultTeacherSoulSettings(), now,
	)
	return soul
}

func testRouter(update *updateStub, getError error) http.Handler {
	teacher := testTeacher()
	soul := testSoul()
	return httptransport.NewRouter(httptransport.RouterDependencies{
		APIPersonalTeacher: &apihandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{
			EnsureUC:     ensureStub{teacher: teacher},
			UpdateUC:     update,
			SoulUC:       soulStub{soul: soul},
			SoulUpdateUC: &soulUpdateStub{soul: soul},
		},
		APITeacherDialog: &apihandlers.TeacherDialogHandler{ProvisionUC: &provisionDialogStub{}},
		AdminPersonalTeacher: &adminhandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{
			GetUC:  getStub{teacher: teacher, err: getError},
			SoulUC: soulStub{soul: soul, err: getError},
		},
		PrivateHealth: &privatehandlers.HealthHandler{
			Ready: func(context.Context) error { return nil },
		},
		InternalToken: "internal-secret",
	})
}

func TestTeacherSoulIsScopedToAuthenticatedStudent(t *testing.T) {
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/teacher/me/soul", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "student-1")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	testRouter(&updateStub{}, nil).ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, recorder.Code)
	require.Contains(t, recorder.Body.String(), `"student_id":"student-1"`)
	require.Contains(t, recorder.Body.String(), `"persona_code":"patient_mentor"`)
}

func TestTeacherSoulUpdatePassesActorAndIndependentVersion(t *testing.T) {
	teacher := testTeacher()
	soul := testSoul()
	updateSoul := &soulUpdateStub{soul: soul}
	router := httptransport.NewRouter(httptransport.RouterDependencies{
		APIPersonalTeacher: &apihandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{
			EnsureUC: ensureStub{teacher: teacher}, UpdateUC: &updateStub{teacher: teacher},
			SoulUC: soulStub{soul: soul}, SoulUpdateUC: updateSoul,
		},
		APITeacherDialog: &apihandlers.TeacherDialogHandler{ProvisionUC: &provisionDialogStub{}},
		AdminPersonalTeacher: &adminhandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{
			GetUC: getStub{teacher: teacher}, SoulUC: soulStub{soul: soul},
		},
		PrivateHealth: &privatehandlers.HealthHandler{Ready: func(context.Context) error { return nil }},
	})
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodPatch, "/api/v1/teacher/me/soul",
		strings.NewReader(`{"expected_version":1,"display_name":"Ada"}`),
	)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "student-1")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT_PRO")
	router.ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, recorder.Code)
	require.NotNil(t, updateSoul.input)
	require.Equal(t, "student-1", updateSoul.input.StudentID)
	require.Equal(t, int64(1), updateSoul.input.ExpectedVersion)
	require.Equal(t, "Ada", *updateSoul.input.DisplayName)
}

func TestGetMyTeacherRequiresStudentIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/teacher/me", nil)
	testRouter(&updateStub{}, nil).ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusUnauthorized, recorder.Code)
}

func TestNextBestActionUsesExactPublicServiceRoute(t *testing.T) {
	getter := &nextActionStub{}
	router := httptransport.NewRouter(httptransport.RouterDependencies{
		APIPersonalTeacher:   &apihandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{},
		APITeacherDialog:     &apihandlers.TeacherDialogHandler{},
		APINextBestAction:    &apihandlers.NextBestActionHandler{Getter: getter},
		AdminPersonalTeacher: &adminhandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{},
	})
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/teacher/me/next-action", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	router.ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, recorder.Code)
	require.Equal(t, "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", getter.studentID)
	require.Contains(t, recorder.Body.String(), `"schema":"student-next-action.v1"`)
}

func TestGetMyTeacherReturnsLogicalTeacher(t *testing.T) {
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/teacher/me", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "student-1")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "student")
	testRouter(&updateStub{}, nil).ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, recorder.Code)
	require.Contains(t, recorder.Body.String(), `"student_id":"student-1"`)
}

func TestUpdateMyTeacherPassesActorAndVersion(t *testing.T) {
	update := &updateStub{teacher: testTeacher()}
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPatch, "/api/v1/teacher/me", strings.NewReader(`{"expected_version":1,"language":"en"}`))
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "student-1")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT_PRO")
	testRouter(update, nil).ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, recorder.Code)
	require.NotNil(t, update.input)
	require.Equal(t, "student-1", update.input.StudentID)
	require.Equal(t, int64(1), update.input.ExpectedVersion)
	require.Equal(t, "en", *update.input.Language)
}

func TestAdminTeacherReadRequiresAdminRole(t *testing.T) {
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/admin/v1/personal-teachers/student-1", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "student-1")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	testRouter(&updateStub{}, nil).ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusForbidden, recorder.Code)
}

func TestAdminTeacherReadMapsMissingTeacher(t *testing.T) {
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/admin/v1/personal-teachers/missing", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "admin-1")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "ADMIN")
	testRouter(&updateStub{}, domain.ErrPersonalTeacherNotFound).ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusNotFound, recorder.Code)
}

func TestPrivateHealthRequiresExactToken(t *testing.T) {
	router := testRouter(&updateStub{}, nil)
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		token  string
		status int
	}{
		{name: "missing", status: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "wrong", token: "wrong", status: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "valid", token: "internal-secret", status: http.StatusOK},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/healthz", nil)
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", testCase.token)
			router.ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
			require.Equal(t, testCase.status, recorder.Code)
		})
	}
}

func TestUpdateConflictMapsToHTTPConflict(t *testing.T) {
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPatch, "/api/v1/teacher/me", strings.NewReader(`{"expected_version":1,"language":"en"}`))
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "student-1")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	testRouter(&updateStub{err: domain.ErrVersionConflict}, nil).ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusConflict, recorder.Code)
}

func TestEnsureTeacherDialogUsesAuthenticatedStudent(t *testing.T) {
	binding := domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson,
		ContextID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", Created: true,
	}
	provision := &provisionDialogStub{binding: binding}
	teacher := testTeacher()
	router := httptransport.NewRouter(httptransport.RouterDependencies{
		APIPersonalTeacher: &apihandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{
			EnsureUC: ensureStub{teacher: teacher}, UpdateUC: &updateStub{teacher: teacher},
			SoulUC: soulStub{soul: testSoul()}, SoulUpdateUC: &soulUpdateStub{soul: testSoul()},
		},
		APITeacherDialog: &apihandlers.TeacherDialogHandler{ProvisionUC: provision},
		AdminPersonalTeacher: &adminhandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{
			GetUC: getStub{teacher: teacher}, SoulUC: soulStub{soul: testSoul()},
		},
	})
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodPut, "/api/v1/teacher-dialog/ensure",
		strings.NewReader(`{"context_type":"lesson","context_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"}`),
	)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", binding.StudentID)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	router.ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusCreated, recorder.Code)
	require.NotNil(t, provision.input)
	require.Equal(t, binding.StudentID, provision.input.StudentID)
	require.Contains(t, recorder.Body.String(), `"created":true`)
}

func TestAdminUnexpectedFailureIsInternalError(t *testing.T) {
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/admin/v1/personal-teachers/student-1", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "admin-1")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "ADMIN")
	testRouter(&updateStub{}, errors.New("database unavailable")).ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusInternalServerError, recorder.Code)
}
